column1: # Original WritingDeck plots; MIT to the extent rights subsist; AI-assisted original drafting.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0327|evidence|mystery,realist|A locksmith opens a safe whose contents have been replaced with photographs of themselves. Each photograph includes the edge of an object that was never listed among the safe's possessions.

wd-p-0328|route|mystery,adventure|A courier finds that every address on her route has been renumbered overnight. The parcels still reach their intended recipients, but the signature required for the last delivery belongs to the person who ordered the renumbering.

wd-p-0329|identity|mystery,realist|A missing person's dentist receives a request to transfer records to a new practice. The request is genuine, but the new practice occupies a building demolished before the disappearance.

wd-p-0330|proof|mystery,political|A city archivist finds a signed order dated before the office that issued it existed. The order saved several homes from demolition, and the forged authority became the legal basis for their present ownership.

wd-p-0331|sequence|mystery,realist|A cleaner notices that a room's dust patterns show its furniture was rearranged twice after a theft. The second arrangement matches photographs taken before the room was officially furnished.

wd-p-0332|trust|mystery,romance|A private investigator hired to verify a partner's alibi finds it entirely accurate. The unexplained part is why the client supplied a photograph that places herself at the same location under another name.

wd-p-0333|resources|mystery,adventure|A hiking group finds its emergency food replaced with carefully labeled stones of equal weight. The labels describe the meals each member privately said they would refuse to share.

wd-p-0334|interpretation|mystery,realist|A crossword setter receives a completed puzzle containing a correct answer she removed before publication. The handwriting belongs to a reader who has been asking about a clue linked to her former business partner.

wd-p-0335|ownership|mystery,family|A family discovers that its heirloom cabinet contains a compartment accessible only when it is disassembled. The cabinet has been repaired by three relatives, each of whom denies knowing about the missing panel.

wd-p-0336|coordination|mystery,political|A journalist follows anonymous tips to several public meetings that all begin early. The minutes remain accurate, but the changed start times explain why a particular group is always recorded as absent.

wd-p-0337|observation|mystery,realist|A train passenger photographs a station clock through a window. The picture appears to prove an alibi until a railway worker identifies the clock as one moved between platforms during renovations.

wd-p-0338|exchange|mystery,realist|A bank teller receives a deposit of coins sorted by the dates of local disappearances. The depositor is a child collecting for a school project whose teacher denies assigning that subject.

wd-p-0339|secrecy|mystery,family|A woman finds identical sealed envelopes hidden in the homes of three relatives. Each contains a different instruction for opening the same storage locker, and all three instructions require another relative's presence.

wd-p-0340|repair|mystery,realist|An electrician repairing a faulty doorbell discovers a wire leading into a vacant neighboring house. Pressing the bell there unlocks a cupboard that both property's owners describe as a solid wall.

wd-p-0341|recognition|mystery,romance|A woman sees her partner in a restored newsreel filmed decades before his birth. The resemblance is explainable, but he recognizes a person just outside the frame whom the restoration has not yet revealed.

wd-p-0342|measurement|mystery,realist|A warehouse auditor finds no missing goods but repeatedly measures empty space where inventory should fit. The crates were made with false bottoms that change what the scale records as packaging.

wd-p-0343|commitment|mystery,adventure|An escape-room designer disappears after replacing a final puzzle with a working key. The key opens the venue's actual service exit, which has been blocked by equipment rented under an employee's name.

wd-p-0344|recordkeeping|mystery,political|A court reporter notices that a witness's pauses were omitted only from one day's transcript. Restoring them changes which questions the witness answered, but the original audio has been requested by the lawyer responsible for the omissions.

wd-p-0345|custom|mystery,family|A family game played at every reunion includes a rule nobody can explain. An outsider follows it literally and finds the route to a property the family believes was sold generations ago.

wd-p-0346|route|mystery,realist|A parcel returns repeatedly to the same depot despite being correctly addressed and scanned. Its owner discovers that each attempted delivery adds a new valid sender to the tracking record.

wd-p-0347|proof|mystery,realist|A forensic examiner finds that a threatening note was typed on the victim's own old machine. The machine was donated to a community workshop, where every person named in the note attended the same repair class.

wd-p-0348|identity|mystery,political|A municipal worker receives complaints from a resident whose address exists only on rejected planning maps. The complaints describe real service failures, and tracing their origin reveals how the city has been hiding occupied housing from its own statistics.

wd-p-0349|observation|mystery,adventure|A sailor finds fresh footprints on a tidal island immediately after the water exposes it. The prints lead from the place where the missing boat should have grounded toward the channel the search team has ruled out.

wd-p-0350|inheritance|mystery,family|An executor finds that every beneficiary has been left a different key to the same empty room. The locks were replaced after the will was written, but the old keyholes remain visible behind a newly hung painting.

wd-p-0351|translation|mystery,realist|A translator discovers that an anonymous warning was written by someone thinking in her own unusual childhood dialect. Identifying the writer requires revisiting the school where she learned to conceal that way of speaking.

wd-p-0352|status|mystery,satire|A hotel hires an inspector to expose a fake guest review. She finds that the review accurately describes a room the hotel publicly denies operating because it is reserved for its own inspectors.

wd-p-0353|sequence|mystery,realist|A photographer finds a roll of film containing two versions of a group portrait. One person changes position, but the shadows show that the supposedly later photograph was exposed first.

wd-p-0354|care|mystery,family|A home nurse discovers that an elderly patient receives medication in bottles from several pharmacies. The prescriptions are not duplicates; they form an exact schedule for treating someone else in the household.

wd-p-0355|territory|mystery,adventure|A survey crew finds a fence that moves a few meters each night. The changing line is not claiming land but tracing the route of a buried conduit someone urgently wants the crew to avoid.

wd-p-0356|value|mystery,realist|A jeweler is asked to appraise a worthless imitation whose wear marks match a famous stolen original. The customer wants proof that it has always been false, not compensation for a recent substitution.

wd-p-0357|trust|mystery,political|An anti-corruption investigator discovers that the anonymous source exposing small bribes is paying them. The payments are real, but each prevents scrutiny of a much larger contract the source is legally entitled to award.

wd-p-0358|attention|mystery,realist|A projectionist notices a single unfamiliar frame in each reel of an old film. Together they show the cinema's own interior at different stages of a renovation its records say never occurred.

wd-p-0359|return|mystery,family|A woman receives a suitcase she lost as a child, packed with clothes in her current size. The luggage tag still bears her old address, where the present occupant claims the suitcase was collected that morning.

wd-p-0360|coordination|mystery,adventure|A rescue organizer receives location updates from a missing climber's device after its battery was recovered separately. The updates follow the organizer's proposed search sectors one step ahead.

wd-p-0361|expertise|mystery,realist|An antiques dealer recognizes a modern tool mark on an apparently ancient object. The mark belongs to a craft technique invented by the expert who has offered to authenticate the collection without charge.

wd-p-0362|consent|mystery,political|A housing inspector receives tenant complaints written in identical language. The tenants confirm every complaint, but the form includes permission for an action none remembers authorizing and one person is already carrying out.

wd-p-0363|inheritance|mystery,romance|A couple restoring an inherited cottage finds two wedding rings concealed in separate walls. Their inscriptions refer to the same wedding date, but neither pair of names appears in the family's public history.

wd-p-0364|proof|mystery,realist|A laboratory finds a suspect's DNA on an object sealed before the suspect was born. The contamination traces to an archival repair rather than the crime, but the repair was commissioned by the person claiming the seal was intact.

wd-p-0365|route|mystery,adventure|A runner follows painted arrows from a canceled race and reaches a house where the race's emergency radio is transmitting. The arrows were laid before the cancellation, but the destination was changed afterward.

wd-p-0366|status|mystery,satire|An investigative reporter finds a town where every public award has gone to the same absent resident. The trophies are being used as receipts for favors performed by several people whom the award committee cannot officially recognize.

wd-p-0367|interpretation|mystery,family|A family recipe instructs the cook to count the windows before adding salt. Following the instruction in the original house reveals that one room was removed from the building's official description.

wd-p-0368|repair|mystery,realist|A watch repairer receives a watch that gains exactly the duration of a client's daily commute. The mechanism is ordinary, but its owner has been using it to support a claim that depends on never leaving home.

wd-p-0369|knowledge|mystery,political|A historian finds that the public archive's missing files all correspond to cases officially settled without dispute. The settlements were valid, but a common witness appears under a different role in each.

wd-p-0370|loyalty|mystery,adventure|A guide recognizes the knot securing a missing explorer's equipment as one taught only during rescue training. The explorer distrusted that training, while the volunteer coordinating the search taught the most recent class.

wd-p-0371|exchange|mystery,realist|A charity auction receives bids that rise only when an item is described inaccurately. The bidder is purchasing evidence of the descriptions, not the objects, and asks for the catalog to remain uncorrected.

wd-p-0372|recordkeeping|mystery,family|A daughter discovers that her father's fishing log records tides for a lake with no significant tide. Matching the numbers to another shoreline reveals where he went during absences the family remembers as holidays together.

wd-p-0373|recognition|mystery,romance|A voice actor hears a private phrase from her relationship in an anonymous commercial audition. The recording is not her partner's voice, but its background includes the unique sound of an appliance in their home.

wd-p-0374|resources|mystery,realist|A restaurant owner finds that supplies disappear only on days when the kitchen's accounts balance perfectly. An apprentice has been correcting a mistaken conversion that makes honest use look like theft.

wd-p-0375|sequence|mystery,political|A public hearing's recording begins with applause for a proposal that was later rejected. The audience was responding to an earlier version, and the official edit has attached that approval to the amendment residents opposed.

wd-p-0376|identity|mystery,adventure|A survivor arrives at a remote lodge carrying the missing guide's emergency pass. She knows every safety code but cannot identify the guide's companions, because the pass was issued for a rehearsal using fictional names.

wd-p-0377|measurement|mystery,realist|A tailor finds that a supposedly new suit was altered to match measurements taken years apart. The changing seams reveal the wearer's repeated visits to a city he claims to have entered only once.

wd-p-0378|secrecy|mystery,family|A grandfather's letters mention a room that no family member remembers. The room appears only in descriptions written during visits by the relative who now insists that every letter be returned unread.

wd-p-0379|access|mystery,political|A locksmith discovers that the master key to a public office also opens a private storage facility. The overlap comes from a bulk order whose missing invoice would identify who chose both locks.

wd-p-0380|observation|mystery,realist|A security guard sees a sculpture rotate slightly every night without anyone entering. Its pedestal is coupled to a mechanism in the locked basement, where the building's former owner stored records awaiting destruction.

wd-p-0381|return|mystery,adventure|A message in a bottle reaches its sender before the missing ship's last known departure date. The date is accurate, but the sender used a schedule printed for a voyage that was delayed without public notice.

wd-p-0382|permission|mystery,romance|A woman learns that a former partner has authorized her to collect an object from a vault. The authorization was signed after their last meeting and describes the object as something she already returned.

wd-p-0383|classification|mystery,realist|A museum inventory lists several objects as shadows of larger exhibits. The entries are a cataloging convention, but one shadow has its own insurance claim and a loan history leading to an empty display case.

wd-p-0384|obligation|mystery,political|A clerk finds a permit approved by every required office, although no office admits receiving it. The approval stamps were applied during a joint training exercise using a real application someone deliberately left among the samples.

wd-p-0385|care|mystery,family|A woman finds that her late mother's grocery orders included food she could not eat. The delivery driver remembers leaving the extra bag at a second door inside the same apartment building.

wd-p-0386|proof|mystery,realist|An investigator's strongest witness correctly identifies an object never shown publicly. The witness learned its appearance from an artist who drew it from an investigator's supposedly hypothetical description.

wd-p-0387|route|mystery,adventure|A delivery pilot follows an emergency landing strip's lights to a field that has been freshly plowed. The original strip is nearby, but someone moved the battery-powered lights to stop a landing on a surface concealing something else.

wd-p-0388|inheritance|mystery,family|A will leaves a debt rather than an asset to the relative best able to repay it. The debtor named in the supporting papers is the testator, and the intended recipient has been refusing repayment for decades.

wd-p-0389|performance|mystery,realist|A theater's prop manager finds a real letter replacing a document in a play. The replacement uses the performer's exact cues to announce information the audience has been invited to hear as fiction.

wd-p-0390|coordination|mystery,political|A reporter notices that officials answer unrelated questions with the same wrong date. The date comes from a briefing document prepared before the event, revealing that the shared account predates the facts it claims to summarize.

wd-p-0391|trust|mystery,romance|A partner's alibi is supported by a dozen strangers who all remember a distinctive coat. The coat was on loan to a repair shop, and identifying its temporary wearer requires asking why the partner reported it lost.

wd-p-0392|measurement|mystery,realist|A restoration architect finds that an old house has more staircase than height. The extra steps were fitted to conceal a lowered floor, and the room below is still receiving deliveries under the building's former address.

wd-p-0393|learning|mystery,family|A retired teacher recognizes a repeated spelling error in anonymous letters sent to her students. The only pupil who made it learned the correction from a parent whose name the letters never mention.

wd-p-0394|scarcity|mystery,adventure|A supply cache in a wilderness shelter contains enough food but no means to open its sealed containers. The missing tool appears in a photograph taken by the group now organizing the search for the last visitors.

wd-p-0395|exchange|mystery,realist|A coin collector receives an ordinary coin with a certificate worth far more than the coin. The certificate establishes attendance at a private sale, and every subsequent owner has been buying the alibi rather than the object.

wd-p-0396|recordkeeping|mystery,political|A district's public repairs are marked complete on the date their complaints were withdrawn. The withdrawals were automatic after correspondence returned undelivered, and the postal contract belongs to the company paid for the repairs.

wd-p-0397|identity|mystery,family|A daughter finds that the names on two family gravestones were transposed. Correcting the mistake would reveal that the person commemorated as leaving home never left, while the one blamed for staying had gone elsewhere.

wd-p-0398|repair|mystery,realist|A violin repairer finds a modern address hidden inside an instrument whose owner died abroad. The address belongs to the person who has repeatedly offered to buy it only if it remains unopened.

wd-p-0399|observation|mystery,adventure|A mountain photographer captures a rescue flare reflected in a lake outside the search area. The direct flare was obscured by the ridge, so the search team has been following the reflection toward the wrong valley.

wd-p-0400|knowledge|mystery,political|An archivist receives a request for a file under a title assigned only after it was sealed. The requester is not an official, but worked for the printer that produced the sealing notices.

wd-p-0401|return|mystery,romance|An old love letter is returned unopened with a new forwarding address. The address belongs to the sender's current partner, who has been preserving the letter because it was never addressed to the person the sender remembers.
